About Mindly


Mindly is an international product company — a marketplace for psychologists and their clients. We have over 1,000,000 clients in more than 40 countries worldwide, with a primary focus on Tier-1 markets. Mindly is one of the fastest-growing companies in the HealthTech sector globally. Our goal is to help people live healthy, happy, and fulfilling lives. We are growing extremely fast and are already profitable! This puts our company in the top 1% of the fastest-growing profitable tech companies in the world! You can read more about us in this article.


We are looking for a Supply Acquisition Manager to join our Success team.


The US is a key market for Mindly, and we’re growing it from the specialist side. In this role, you’ll bring licensed American therapists onto the platform and make sure they have a great experience with us, from smooth onboarding to a long-term, successful partnership.

Why is this interesting?

  • The #1 product in our niche, growing fast with real momentum

  • You'll have a real impact on the user experience — the early specialists you bring on become Mindly's top advocates in the US

  • Direct access to decision-makers — you'll work closely with our CMO, CEO, and the Success team

About you:

  • English at C2 level or near-native — you'll be representing Mindly on video calls

  • Background in sales, or in a support/success role

  • Experience working with the US market or in an English-speaking work environment — live conversations, not just messages

  • Open to working evening or early hours aligned with US time zones

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken

  • Comfortable handling objections and pushback on camera, not just in chat

  • Able to stay calm and patient in tough situations

Your responsibilities:

  • Reach out to and sign up licensed American therapists for Mindly, clearly explaining why Mindly is the best choice

  • Source specialists yourself across job boards, professional communities, and relevant groups

  • Onboard specialists and support them so they succeed on the platform — essentially performing a success manager role as well

  • Turn early specialists into the platform's top advocates in the US

  • Run calls primarily during US hours, with sourcing and admin work earlier in the day

How we get things done?

Remote-first, but this role runs on US time zone — expect calls running into the evening (Kyiv time), with sourcing and admin work earlier in the day

How do we unwind?

We offer our team 20 days of paid vacation, unlimited sick-leave and national holidays as an extra day-offs

What do we offer?

  • A fast-growing product company where you are a key part of our success

  • Competitive base salary

  • Therapy on Mindly

  • A strong team of A-players

Candidate journey:

  • AI Interview screen

  • Interview with Recruiter

  • Interview with the CMO - focused on sales skills

  • Final interview with the CEO, fully in English

  • Offer 🎉

Our values:

  • Honesty and transparency: always tell the truth, no matter what it is

  • Empathy and understanding: treat others the way you want to be treated
